title: To Dict
description: Take multiple columns and merge them to a dictionary (aka object) using the column headers as keys.

parameters.name: include_empty
parameters.description: Whether to include empty columns in the created dictionary.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Take multiple columns and merge them to a dictionary (aka object) using the column headers as keys. ## Migrated examples #### Merging Two Columns Into a Dictionary ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - merge.to_dict: input: - Col1 - Col2 output: Dict Col ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | Col2 | | --- | --- | | A | B |
##### Output Sample | Dict Col | | --- | | \{'Col1': 'A', 'Col2': 'B'\} |
